message: Unpinned GitHub Action detected: a workflow references an action by a tag or branch (owner/repo at a movable ref) rather than a full 40-character commit SHA, a docker:// image has no @sha256: digest, or a line check cannot read the ref (an escape, an open quote). Pin it to the lowercase SHA or digest -- keep the version in a trailing comment for readability -- so a re-tagged or compromised release cannot change what runs. Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist unpinned-action' on the same line. A person's commit honours it; in the agent (write, the turn's end, an agent's commit) only a line already in HEAD counts, and the MCP gateway never does. An agent asks a person; it never writes the pragma.

params.content_pattern:
(?x)
# 1. a uses key (bare, quoted, flow or JSON; anchor or tag allowed) naming a remote action
#    or reusable workflow at a non-SHA ref, or a docker:// image without a digest
["']?use[s]["']?\s*:\s*(?:[&!]\S*\s+)*["']?
  (?: (?!(?i:docker)://|\./) [^\s"'@,\]}]+ @ (?![0-9a-f]{40}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$))
    | (?i:docker):// (?![^\s"'@,\]}]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$)) )
# 2. an action's image key holding a docker:// image without a digest
| ["']?imag[e]["']?\s*:\s*(?:[&!]\S*\s+)*["']?
    (?i:docker):// (?![^\s"'@,\]}]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$))
# 3. a quoted uses value this check cannot read: an escape, or a quote left open
| ["']?use[s]["']?\s*:\s*(?:[&!]\S*\s+)*(?:"[^"]*(?:\\|$)|'[^']*$)
# 4. an anchor holding an owner/repo@non-SHA or docker:// value, or an escaped one
| &\S+\s+(?: "[^"]*\\
    | ["']? [A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:/[^\s"'@]*)? @ (?![0-9a-f]{40}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$))
    | ["']? (?i:docker):// (?![^\s"'@,\]}]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$)) )
# 5. a value alone on its line (uses:, uses: >- or a complex key above it)
| ^\s*(?::\s+)?(?:[&!]\S*\s+)*["']?
    (?: [A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:/[^\s"'@]*)? @ (?![0-9a-f]{40}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$))
      | (?i:docker):// (?![^\s"'@,\]}]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}(?:["'\s,\]}]|$)) )
    \S*\s*(?:\#.*)?$
# 6. a bare double-quoted line escaping a slash; an escaped key; an escaped @ anywhere
| ^\s*"[^"]*\\(?:/|x2[fF]|u002[fF]|U0000002[fF])
| (?:^\s*(?:[-?]\s+)*|[{,]\s*) "[^"]*\\(?:[^"]*"\s*:|$)
| \\(?:x40|u0040|U00000040)
